answer: Offers issued before February 1, 2026 keep their original terms of 7 days or 300 additional miles, whichever comes first. Since your offer was issued in December 2025, you could have driven up to 300 additional miles before it expired, provided you were still within 7 days. If the offer has expired, you can request a new one at any time, and the new amount will reflect current market prices.
